value.signature: async fn cancel (& self) -> Result < () , Refusal >

review.body: { let result = self . cancel_inner () . await ; if let Err (cause) = & result { tracing :: warn ! (outcome = "error" , cause = ? cause , "store cancellation failed") ; } result }
review.item_premise: The private raw client has no production accessor. Role-only carriers protect configuration, keys and diagnostics; exact frame buffers stay secret-owned until the checked public filter. Public session formatting reveals only the declared case, connection state and disabled persistence. Future-aware spans enter only when polled. Independent relay tasks report bounded terminal causes under their own operation; the connect span ends at handoff rather than measuring the session.
